minutes.headline: Board ratified two police sergeants and approved the cheaper Lane land purchase; police mutual aid pact held for review.
minutes.summary: The board reorganized after the election, appointed a library trustee, and ratified two police sergeant promotions. It approved an amended purchase and sale agreement for the Lane property and its naming. It held the Middlesex County police mutual aid agreement for more review, discussed the town manager's evaluation, and heard committee reports.

what_happened.line: The board unanimously approved the revised purchase and sale agreement and the naming of the Lane property at Lunenburg Town Forest.
The appraisal set the Lane purchase price below the amount approved at town meeting, and a state land grant would cover part of it.
The board ratified the promotion of two acting sergeants to police sergeant, with none opposed.
The Middlesex County police mutual aid agreement was held until the board compares it with the Worcester County agreement.
After the election the board reorganized, electing a vice chair and clerk, and appointed a library trustee to the vacant seat until the next election.

why_it_matters: The Lane land purchase will cost the town less than the amount voters approved at town meeting, with a state grant covering a share, so less of the town budget, mostly taxes, is needed for it.
The held mutual aid agreement sets how neighboring police departments share help, so it bears on emergency coverage and on what the town commits to when it signs.
